steps.code:
# Now let me fetch all received transactions this month. I'll paginate through all pages.
access_token = login_response["access_token"]
all_received = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=access_token,
        direction="received",
        min_created_at=start_of_month,
        max_created_at=today,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=20
    )
    if not resp:
        break
    all_received.extend(resp)
    if len(resp) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total received transactions: {len(all_received)}")
for t in all_received:
    print(t["amount"], t["created_at"], t["sender"]["name"])
